decisions.reason: After four years the firm likely has enough field feedback to judge it, but as a resin-processing unit close to its core capabilities it still has option value and relatively low support cost unless demand proved clearly weak.

Management would keep it for now, though the probability of withdrawal is somewhat higher because it overlaps with another two-component resin injection unit and a medium-sized firm will rationalize close substitutes if volumes are limited.
An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's established spray-application portfolio, so if it remains marketed by 2022 the low cost of continuing and strong fit argue for retention.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard product for this customer base and typically enjoys a long life in German industrial equipment catalogues, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
Because this is a multi-model product line in a core application area, it preserves broad coverage across customer needs and offers high continuing option value relative to its maintenance cost.

The data logger is the most peripheral offering, and by 2022 the firm would likely have learned enough about adoption to exit if the digital complement has not gained clear traction against the pull of core mechanical products.
